title: Adding 2 refinementList doesn't merge the underlying query parameters
body: The query is sent with a single `facets: ["lastRefinementListFacet"]` at the end.

comments.body: ~~Yes we need to use https://lodash.com/docs#defaultsDeep instead of merge here~~
